title: Sum until stop
prompt: sum_until_stop(values) adds numbers until the word "stop" appears (not included). None entries should be skipped. It hangs whenever the list contains None.
hints: Only lists containing None hang. What does 'continue' do?
'continue' jumps straight back to the while condition and skips i += 1, so i never moves past the None.
Make sure i is increased on every pass, for example by adding to total only when the value is not None.
explanation: 'continue' skipped the 'i += 1' at the bottom of the loop, so the loop kept looking at the same None forever.
